name: inv-attractive-negative
natural_language: A pair is attractive if and only if their charges have opposite signs.

name: inv-distance-positive
natural_language: No two distinct charges can occupy the same position (would produce infinite force).

name: inv-field-superposition
algebraic_statement: E_total = Σ E_i (vector sum over all source charges)
natural_language: Electric fields obey the superposition principle: total field at a point is the vector sum of individual fields.

name: inv-force-inverse-sq
algebraic_statement: F ∝ 1/r²: doubling distance quarters the force
natural_language: Coulomb's Law is an inverse-square law: force falls off with the square of distance.

name: inv-force-symmetry
natural_language: Newton's 3rd law: the magnitude of the force each charge exerts on the other must be equal.

name: inv-neutral-system
algebraic_statement: TotalCharge = Σ q_i for IsNeutral systems ≈ 0
natural_language: Electrically neutral systems have zero net charge.

name: inv-repulsive-positive
natural_language: A pair is repulsive if and only if their charges have the same sign.

name: inv-unit-vector-length
natural_language: The displacement unit vector must have magnitude 1 for all non-zero separations.
